derivation: Derived GEOMETRICALLY from the real TY2025 f1040.pdf (IRS fillable form), not from field-name numbering: for every entry, the widget /Rect of the field (read with pypdf) was matched against the printed line labels extracted with `pdftotext -bbox` on the blank form; a field is assigned to the line whose printed label sits on the same row (widget y-center within ~6pt of the label row). The spikes/pdf-fill/targets.json hints were treated as unverified and several proved wrong (e.g. its second candidate set points line 11/15 at dependents-table fields f1_39/f1_43). TY2025 numbering notes: the form prints AGI as line 11a (page 1) repeated as 11b (page 2); the standard-deduction amount box is line 12e (12a-12d are claim/checkbox items); the capital gain line is printed as 7a. Engine line numbers follow the engine's own numbering (7, 11, 12), so `source_line` records which engine line feeds each form field when they differ.

entries.note: Row label: '1a Total amount from Form(s) W-2, box 1 ... 1a' (page 1, right amount column).
Row label: 'z Add lines 1a through 1h ... 1z' (page 1).
Mid-column box on the row labeled '2a Tax-exempt interest ... 2a / b Taxable interest ... 2b' (page 1).
Right amount column on the 2a/2b row (page 1).
Mid-column box on the row labeled '3a Qualified dividends ... 3a / b Ordinary dividends ... 3b' (page 1).
Right amount column on the 3a/3b row (page 1).
TY2025 prints this line as '7a Capital gain or (loss). Attach Schedule D if required ... 7a' (page 1); engine line 7 is the same amount.
Row label: '9 Add lines 1z, 2b, 3b, 4b, 5b, 6b, 7a, and 8. This is your total income ... 9' (page 1).
TY2025 prints AGI as line 11a: '11a Subtract line 10 from line 9. This is your adjusted gross income ... 11a' (page 1, last row).
Form line 11b, 'Amount from line 11a (adjusted gross income)' (page 2, first row): the form repeats AGI at the top of page 2, so engine line 11 fills this field as well.
TY2025 prints the standard-deduction amount at line 12e: 'e Standard deduction or itemized deductions (from Schedule A) ... 12e' (page 2). Engine line 12 is the standard deduction.

Form line 14 = 12e + 13a + 13b. The engine computes no 13a/13b amounts, so 14 equals the standard deduction (engine line 12) on any return this engine can produce; filled so the printed form is arithmetically consistent (15 = 11b - 14).
Row label: '15 Subtract line 14 from line 11b ... This is your taxable income' (page 2).
Row label: '16 Tax (see instructions) ... 16' (page 2, right amount column; the mid-column f2_07 on the same row is the Form 8814/4972 checkbox-amount area, not the line total).

Form line 24 = 22 + 23 (total tax). The engine computes no line 17-23 amounts, so line 24 equals line 16 on any return this engine can produce; filled from engine line 16 for the same consistency reason as line 14.
Mid-column box on the row labeled 'a Form(s) W-2 ... 25a' under line 25 (page 2).
Row label: 'd Add lines 25a through 25c ... 25d' (page 2, right amount column).
Row label: '33 Add lines 25d, 26, and 32. These are your total payments ... 33' (page 2).
Row label: '34 If line 33 is more than line 24 ... This is the amount you overpaid ... 34' (page 2). Mutually exclusive with line 37: filled only when > 0.
Row label '37' in the 'You Owe' section (page 2). Mutually exclusive with line 34: filled only when > 0.

Left filing-status column, second row, beside 'Married filing jointly (even if only one had income)'; on-state /2.
Left filing-status column, third row, beside 'Married filing separately (MFS)'; on-state /3.

Right filing-status column, first row, beside 'Head of household (HOH)'; on-state /4. Same leaf name c1_8[0] as the Single field under a different parent (the duplicate-leaf collision the button fill path resolves by qualified name).
